limitations: Finite observed envelope; no universal upper bound.
Six lengths and two content schedules do not cover SHA padding boundaries or arbitrary messages.
Count contrasts include loop/check work and are not isolated SHA costs.
The four recent small-input regressions are already opened, not independent holdout.
Old and current observer match on a retained common input; this is finite parity, not general attestation.
CPU SDK6.3 gas estimator and b76 ELF; production/GPU proving-time parity is not established.
Natural quote reports omit per-op counters, so global SHA256 frequency is unknown.

policy.absolute_metrics: retain whole-proposal actual, literal per-block node sums and full quotes, including controls/startup
policy.formula: smallest C>=0 with max(C,42*native_gas) >= (5/4)*max(0,delta_PGU/extra_SHA_calls) for all same-length/pattern count pairs
